Triptych.question: What do you know about A triptych ( TRIP-tik)?
Triptych.answer: a work of art (usually a panel painting) that is divided into three sections, or three carved panels that are hinged tog
Triptych.fact: A triptych ( TRIP-tik) is a work of art (usually a panel painting) that is divided into three sections, or three carved panels that are hinged together and can be folded shut or displayed open. The middle panel is typically the largest and flanked by two smaller related works, although there are triptychs of equal-sized panels.
